maria: Heads-up — Aurora Dedicated rollout scheduled for Fri 2026-03-12 22:00-23:30 UTC :calendar:.
maria: Change window 90m. Target model: oak/v3.2.1-quant (quantized GPU build). Need final approvals, rollback plan, and confirmation we can pin traffic at canary steps.
jyoti: Proposed rollout: canary 10% (10m), expand 50% (20m), full 100% (rest). We'll keep autoscale disabled during canary. Sounds ok?
sam: Dashboards: perf, error budgets, and response-quality eval will be live. Alerts for p95 >250ms or 5xx >1%.
lucas: Oncall here. Rollback triggers: p95 >250ms for 5m or 5xx >1% sustained for 3m. If triggered we rollback to oak/v3.1.9 and route traffic to fallback pool.
jyoti: Rollback commands in runbook:
```
# pin traffic to old model
redwoodctl rollout set aurora --model oak/v3.1.9 --force
# rollback deploy
redwoodctl deploy rollback --customer aurora --to oak/v3.1.9
```
jyoti: Also will pin model version in config to avoid auto-updates during window.
anna: Aurora (CS) confirms cert rotation is done and they signed off on change window. They expect a short interruption up to 30s.
maria: Need explicit approvals to proceed. @sam @lucas @jyoti please :thumbsup: if ok.
sam: :thumbsup:
jyoti: :thumbsup:
lucas: :thumbsup: (oncall ready)
deploy-bot: Scheduled job 789031 for aurora-dedicated-rollout, start_ts=1769150000, workflow=dedicated-rollout-v2. Steps: preflight -> canary -> expand -> finalize. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/aurora-dedicated
maria: One more: pin traffic policy — we'll use staged routing with immediate fallback to v3.1.9 on error. No schema changes.
jyoti: Confirmed. We will also run prompt-sanity checks against golden set after canary.
lucas: I'll monitor. If anything weird, I'll pause expansion and notify @maria.
maria: Approved and scheduled. Post any preflight failures here. Thanks everyone :rocket:
